items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 01 August 2026 at 7:45am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Low over the Norwegian Sea. High to the southwest of Iceland with a ridge to Biscay.


##Wind##

West 3 or 4, backing southwest this afternoon and increasing 4 or 5 for a time, becoming variable 3 or less tonight.


##State of Sea##

Mostly slight becoming smooth or slight later.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Mostly good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Variable 3 or less, settling east or southeast 2 or 3 during Sunday morning, increasing east or northeast 4 or 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, becoming slight.


##Weather##

Fair, then occasional, patchy light rain developing later Sunday evening and overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate later.
